title: Card 5: data code se baanto (ring). Code ki machine + agli 2 pe copy

callouts.red: Country se baant dete, ya ek badi machine le lete?
callouts.green: Country: code dekh ke pata nahi, saari machine poochni padti
callouts.green2: Ek machine: 90 TB usme aata hi nahi

callouts.red: Seedha code % machine se baant dete?
callouts.green: Machine judi to lagbhag saari keys hilti (3 se 4 = sab badle)
callouts.green2: Ring me sirf pados ki keys hilti

callouts.green: Baaki 2 copy se milta, ek bhi link nahi gaya

callouts.red: Ek machine pe zyada bojh aa gaya
callouts.green: Virtual nodes: har machine ring pe 100-200 jagah baithti, bojh barabar

callouts.red: Data sirf ~500 GB hota to? Ek MySQL kaafi. Shard tab, jab ek machine me na aaye.
callouts.green: Cassandra kyun? Join / transaction chahiye hi nahi, bas code se link, aur 90 TB

callouts.red: Cassandra me primary copy kaunsi? Koi nahi, teeno barabar, koi bhi likh / padh sakti.
callouts.green: Copy badhane se likhna tez? Nahi, har copy pe likhna padta. Likhne ka bojh = shard

kyun: Click hamesha code ke saath aata hai, to har click seedha ek machine pe jaata
